decision: built two domain services plus an engine rather than one service
why: the value is the boundary between services that own state and an engine that only proposes

decision: workflows are data, not code
why: the ask is a builder where customers compose workflows, so the engine has to compile a saved definition

decision: enforced platform invariants in the validator
why: user-authored automation that can move pay without a human is the failure mode worth designing out

decision: Bun plus Elysia plus Eden on Postgres
why: Drizzle keeps the runtime free of native binaries and Eden gives the UI the server's types

decision: event backbone behind a port, Redis Streams locally
why: one broker for the demo while keeping consumer groups, replay, and per-tenant ordering

decision: BullMQ for execution and LangGraph for the graph
why: approval latency must not depend on worker lifetime, and retries and DLQ stay ours

decision: transactional outbox with skinny events
why: avoids the dual-write bug and matches the skinny webhooks Humanforce HR already emits

decision: wrote contracts and the DSL before any service
why: the five build slices compile against one interface instead of negotiating

decision: canvas geometry stored as layout beside the DSL
why: React Flow positions are UI metadata and must not leak into the executable definition

decision: proved the outbox and the Redis backbone against real infra
why: these carry the at-least-once and dedupe claims, so they cannot rest on a mock

decision: studio migrations as plain SQL applied by a tracked migrator
why: a reviewer can read the schema in a diff and a rerun is a no-op

decision: env files symlinked into each workspace
why: bun and next read .env from their own cwd, and one source of truth beats four

decision: workflows became a DSL with a validator and a compiler
why: the approved ask is a drag-and-drop builder, which needs definitions the engine compiles

decision: found the stalled runs were BullMQ rejecting job ids containing ":"
why: every enqueue threw after the dedupe row was written, so runs sat queued forever

decision: made redelivery re-enqueue stranded queued runs
why: a failed enqueue could otherwise lose a run permanently despite at-least-once delivery

decision: an employee cancelling now vacates the shift instead of cancelling it
why: the coverage workflow must be able to fill the shift the sick employee vacated, and the service refused offers on a cancelled shift

decision: jsonb parameters are passed as text and cast $n::text::jsonb
why: the driver stores a JSON string as a jsonb string scalar, and the tagged template rejects object parameters

decision: fixed the overview reading a wrapped workflows object
why: the API returns an array and the page crashed on first load

decision: ran scripts/verify.sh as the single definition of done
why: infra, migrations, seed, four processes, and the two scenarios in one command

decision: browser-verified the whole loop, not just the API
why: the demo is judged on the UI: canvas, validation block, approval card, live timeline
result: run succeeded in 17s, shift status offered
